designationHistory.indexText: Glacial Ridge National Wildlife Refuge was established when The Nature Conservancy began transferring restored prairie and wetland to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service.

authority.citation: Land transfer from The Nature Conservancy

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
